cro: shall immediately execute the actions listed for each trip scenario

field_operator: shall confirm valve positions physically within 10 minutes of a trip

automatic_action: Open converter bypass damper DV-201; start emergency quench air injection
operator_response_required: Confirm DV-201 open and quench air flowing; reduce sulfur feed to zero if not already tripped

automatic_action: Stop acid pump P-107; close acid valve XV-301
operator_response_required: Verify pump stopped and valve closed; check pump mechanical seal

automatic_action: Initiate stack emergency scrubber; trip sulfur feed
operator_response_required: Evacuate downwind area; sound site alarm; notify Environmental Manager

automatic_action: All control valves fail to safe position per P&ID
operator_response_required: Verify valve positions; shut down plant manually if needed

requirement: All trip events shall be logged in the Trip Log (LOG-ESD-001) within 15 minutes of occurrence

cro: Reduce sulfur feed to zero at a rate not exceeding 100 kg/h per minute
Stop combustion air blower after burner temperature drops below 300°C
Continue acid circulation for at least 30 minutes to cool the converter
Close all acid transfer valves to storage

field_operator: If a spill is detected, the Field Operator shall immediately isolate the source and activate the containment sump pump

requirement: Prior to any maintenance work, the equipment must be isolated from all hazardous energy sources and locked out in accordance with Apex LOTO Standard STD-SAF-012.
shall verify zero energy state and issue a safety work permit before work commences.

maintenance_requirement: Inspect and grease bearings and check seal integrity every 2,000 operating hours; performed by Maintenance Technician.
Perform vibration analysis and bearing temperature check, replace oil every 4,000 operating hours; performed by Condition Monitoring Technician.
Overhaul (replace mechanical seal, impeller wear rings) every 8,000 operating hours or 12 months, whichever first; performed by Maintenance Fitter.
Internal inspection and catalyst sampling every 4 years; performed by Inspection Engineer.
Check packing and acid distributor, clean every 2 years; performed by Process Engineer.

calibration_requirement: Calibrate every 7 days using span gas at 10.0% SO₂; performed by Instrument Technician.
Calibrate every 3 months by 3-point check vs certified RTD; performed by Instrument Technician.
Calibrate every 6 months using deadweight tester; performed by Instrument Technician.
instrument: Differential pressure transmitters ΔP-201 to ΔP-204

calibration_requirement: Verify calibration every 6 months by clamp-on ultrasonic method; performed by Instrument Technician.

requirement: requires a hot work permit and continuous gas monitoring for SO₂ and H₂S.
condition: All hot work within 15 m of the sulfur melter

requirement: requires a confined space permit, atmospheric testing, and a standby person.
condition: Confined space entry into the converter vessel or absorption tower

control_room_operator: responsible for monitoring all process parameters, initiating control actions, and logging data

field_operator: responsible for physical rounds, sampling, and verification of local gauge readings

shift_supervisor: has authority to approve deviations from normal operating targets and to authorise interlock bypasses

condition: All safety interlocks tested and enabled with no active trips

acid_circulation_pump_p_107a: available and seal flush water flowing

action: Start acid circulation pump P-107A and establish a flow rate of at least 600 m³/h through the absorption tower
Initiate combustion air blower B-103 and adjust air flow to 12,000 Nm³/h
Light sulfur burner F-102 and increase sulfur feed at a rate not exceeding 50 kg/h per minute until reaching 2000 kg/h
slowly raise sulfur feed to normal range while adjusting air flow to maintain SO2 concentration at 10.0–10.5% vol

high_high_trip_interlock_action: Trip at 4700 kg/h: close sulfur feed valve XV-101 and initiate automatic water wash of burner
Trip at 620°C: open converter bypass damper DV-201 and initiate emergency cooling
Trip at 97.5% or 99.2%: close acid product valve and divert to spill tank

interlock_bypass: requires written authorisation from the Shift Supervisor and must be recorded in the bypass log

burner_management_system_bms_logic: performs a pre-purge of the combustion chamber for 60 seconds before allowing ignition

loss_of_instrument_air: fail-safe valves shall move to their safe positions as specified in P&ID 02-01

outgoing_cro_duty: complete the Shift Handover Log (form OP-LOG-001) and verbally brief the incoming CRO on current operating status, alarms, and maintenance activities

required_data: SO2 feed rate, Bed 1 outlet temperature, acid concentration, and any alarm occurrences

field_operator_duty: measure absorption acid concentration every 2 hours using the hydrometer and record the value in the log

online_so2_analyzer_ai_201_calibration: every 7 days by the Instrument Technician using certified 10.0% SO₂ span gas

notification_limit: If ΔP exceeds 150 mbar, the Shift Supervisor shall be notified

bed_1_catalyst_replacement_criteria: after 30,000 cumulative operating hours or if ΔP persists above 150 mbar after screening
